items.en: Ukraine says an intercepted Russian document plans up to 1,000 missiles, drones and bombs against 60 Ukrainian infrastructure targets this winter
items.nl: Oekraïne zegt dat een onderschept Russisch document deze winter tot 1.000 raketten, drones en bommen tegen 60 Oekraïense infrastructuurdoelen voorziet
items.sEn: Ukraine says it has obtained a Russian plan for a winter strike campaign against its critical infrastructure. Euromaidan Press, citing The New York Times (2 October) and RFE/RL's Schemes project (8 October), reports that the Russian-language document is dated August and lists 60 key targets to be hit with up to 1,000…

items.en: Ukraine unveils home-built 'Koral' air-defense missile with claimed anti-ballistic role at MSPO 2026

items.sEn: At Poland's MSPO 2026 defense exhibition in Kielce (8–11 September 2026), Ukraine publicly displayed its domestically developed "Koral" (also spelled "Coral"; Ukrainian Корал) surface-to-air missile for the first time, alongside a launcher concept. items.en: HUR: Russia failed to substitute Western chips in the Kinzhal missile and reverted to US-made processors
items.nl: HUR: Rusland slaagde er niet in westerse chips in de Kinzjal-raket te vervangen en keerde terug naar Amerikaanse processoren
items.sEn: According to Vladyslav Vlasiuk, the Ukrainian president's commissioner for sanctions policy, Russia's effort to substitute Western microelectronics in the Kh-47M2 Kinzhal missile with domestic chips has failed. items.en: Ukraine's foreign intelligence: European NATO members may be a 'second target' of Russia's winter missile buildup
items.nl: Oekraïense buitenlandse inlichtingendienst: Europese NAVO-landen mogelijk 'tweede doelwit' van Russische winter-rakettenopbouw
items.sEn: Ukraine's Foreign Intelligence Service (SZRU) has warned that European NATO members may become a "second target" of Russia's winter missile buildup, alongside primary strikes on Ukraine's critical infrastructure and power grid. Major General Oleh Luhovskyi presented the assessment to European national security advisor…
items.sNl: De Oekraïense Buitenlandse Inlichtingendienst (SZRU) heeft gewaarschuwd dat Europese NAVO-landen een "tweede doelwit" kunnen worden van de Russische rakettenopbouw voor de winter, na primaire aanvallen op de Oekraïense kritieke infrastructuur en het energienet. items.en: Why Does Russia Need More Than 40 MiG-31 Kinzhal Carriers if It Has Only About 100 Missiles?
items.nl: Waarom heeft Rusland meer dan 40 MiG-31 Kinzhal-dragers nodig als het maar zo'n 100 raketten heeft?
